title: L'équité dans le traitement automatique des langues : des méthodes traditionnelles vers l'explicabilité

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the disparity in prediction outcomes between male and female profiles on occupation classification tasks using metrics like True Positive Rate (TPR) gap, Group Parity (GP), and Predictive Parity (PP), as well as evaluating the implicit encoding of gender information in model embeddings using sensitivity analysis and concept removal.
